invariants.name: No completed work silently disappears
invariants.statement: An officially accepted node result must never be treated as never-executed after restart.
invariants.stack_a: SATISFIED: PHASE_PASSED journal event + result.json artifact + phaseResultHashes pinned in checkpoint; resume restores completedPhaseIds and never re-runs them (test 19).
invariants.stack_b: NOT SATISFIED: node results are in-memory; crash loses them.

invariants.name: No uncommitted work becomes completed
invariants.statement: A crash-intermediate state must never be promoted to PASS.
invariants.stack_a: SATISFIED: only a journaled PHASE_PASSED at a checkpoint boundary is a completed result; interrupted phases are requeued (read-only) or RECOVERY_REQUIRED (writer); EXECUTOR_ERROR/TIMEOUT/ABORTED are HOLD (tests 21/22/32/33/34).
invariants.stack_b: PARTIAL: lifecycle-runner maps errors to HOLD in-process; no durable promotion.

invariants.name: Writer side effects are never blindly replayed
invariants.statement: Any source mutation must be identity/checkpoint/verification aware; a crash mid-writer must not replay the mutation.
invariants.stack_a: SATISFIED (fail-closed): interrupted writer phase -> INTERRUPTED_WRITER_PHASE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED; resume refuses; writer lease pinned in checkpoint; stale lease remnant rejects (tests 22/23).
invariants.stack_b: PARTIAL: writer mutation confined to isolated worktree (colima-worktree); worktree persists on crash but graph does not auto-replay; however there is no persisted writer-lease/verification gate across restart.

invariants.name: Review and repair budgets survive restart
invariants.statement: Restart must not reset the repair budget.
invariants.stack_a: SATISFIED: maxRepairAttempts frozen in configuration fingerprint (sourceHashes + policy) and restored from resume_policy on resume; attempt counter persisted in phaseAttempts.
invariants.stack_b: NOT SATISFIED: repair budget is in-memory; restart resets it.

invariants.name: Graph dependencies survive restart
invariants.statement: The ready set must be rebuilt from durable truth, not from old process memory.
invariants.stack_a: SATISFIED: phase_states + completed_phase_ids + newlySkipped in checkpoint feed initialState into runDecompositionGraph on resume (tests 19/20/24).
invariants.stack_b: NOT SATISFIED: ready set derived in-memory each run.

invariants.name: Memory write-back is idempotent
invariants.statement: Recovery must not produce duplicate trusted memory.
invariants.stack_a: N/A (durable path does not wire CBM-4).
invariants.stack_b: SATISFIED (CBM-4): recordId deterministic; journal-first explicitImport; exact duplicate -> WRITEBACK_DUPLICATE; crash between journal/sqlite -> lossless rebuild; repeated closeout -> one CURRENT record (CBM-4 tests G2/G3/G15/CL3).

invariants.name: Telemetry is replay-aware
invariants.statement: Restart/replay must not count one operation as two independent success events.
invariants.stack_a: GAP: the durable layer journals operations but COST-1 telemetry has no replay marker; a resumed run's re-executed read-only phases would emit duplicate telemetry events unless the observer dedups by executionId+attempt (needs verification).
invariants.stack_b: SATISFIED-ish: graph telemetry observer runs once post-final; CBM-4 memory.writeback telemetry emitted once per write-back outcome (idempotent with the write).

invariants.name: Authority survives recovery
invariants.statement: Restart must never elevate Agent/writer/reviewer authority.
invariants.stack_a: SATISFIED: configuration fingerprint includes source hashes + adapter policy hashes; resume rejects any config drift; writer authority re-derived from the frozen IR (requiresWriterLease), never from process memory.
invariants.stack_b: SATISFIED: authority derived from caller-supplied IR + CBM-4 trust gate; no persisted authority that could be elevated.

gapSummary: STACK_A satisfies all D1-D8 except D7 (telemetry replay-awareness at the durable layer). STACK_B (production Graph path) fails D1 and D5 outright and does not preserve D4 across restart. The dominant gap is the absence of durable wiring on the production Graph path, not the absence of a durable engine.
